limits: Fixture identities and Redis INCR fence minting; no production authentication, Aurora, full Hub catch-up, Rust/FUSE, or model agents.
Each outage has 16 independent targets, spread across two server connections. The 1000-identity sequential queue benchmark runs separately before the faults.
Four-second interruptions only. Redis restart retains AOF data; replica failover, loss of acknowledged state and prolonged partitions are not tested.
The fixture gap callback records Redis subscriber interruption; production Hub reconnect/catch-up behavior is not exercised.
The stats field in each result records pre-fault notification tests, not post-outage connection-error totals.
These are single sequential runs, not latency distributions or a controlled production throughput comparison. Persistence settings differ between fault and control runs.
